Fairy Culture

Every so often a caravan follows a strange light off the road and doesn't come back. A few of those caravans find their way into the Feywild, and some of them decide they like it there.

Living among the fey changes a Fenari faster than any other host. Within a generation or two they shrink, their colors turn vivid and impossible (sunset orange, sea-glass blue, lilac fur with silver tips), and a pair of gossamer wings sprouts from their shoulders. Fairy Fenari soon learn the fey habits of trading in riddles, favors, and very carefully worded promises.

When they return to the mortal world, Fairy Fenari make for delightful and slightly alarming traveling companions: endlessly curious, quick to fly off after anything shiny, and absolutely certain that the rules don't apply to them.

Alignment. Fairy Fenari tend toward chaotic neutral.

Fenari Traits

  • Size. Living among the fey has made these Fenari smaller than their kin, most growing between 3'4" and 4'2" tall and weighing 40 to 60 pounds. Your size is Small.
  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Languages. Common and Sylvan.
  • Fairy Flight. You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, which you can't use while wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

See the The Fenari journal for the Fenari's history, Creed, and appearance.
